text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see... That must have been rough...
Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm glad to hear that... Yes... Take
care...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Took a while, but at least she's
feeling
better now...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's late. I should head back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe seems exhausted after
talking to
someone (or something) night
after night.
